bar.label: Subtitle controls
ai.title: AI subtitles
ai.desc: SubBot writes subtitles from the video's sound in your browser, and switches to a TSDB file if it hears one that matches.
ai.model: Downloading the speech model, $1 of $2. Only the first time.
ai.paused: Paused while captions are off in the player
ai.done: Done: $1 lines, written on this device.
ai.done.one: Done: $1 line, written on this device.
ai.identified: SubBot recognised this video and switched to TSDB file $1 ($2).
ai.why.notStarted: This video has not started loading yet. Press play, then try again.
ai.why.ownPlayer: This site streams video through its own player, so SubBot cannot read the audio. It works on videos that play from a file or a stream address.
ai.why.http: SubBot can only read videos served over http or https.
ai.err.gone: That video is gone. Open this again.
ai.err.noSource: This video has no source SubBot can read.
ai.err.audio: The video server would not let SubBot read the audio.
ai.err.format: SubBot cannot decode this video format yet.
ai.err.noAudio: This video has no sound to transcribe.
ai.err.webcodecs: This browser cannot decode audio for SubBot. Update it and try again.
ai.err.model: The speech model did not download. Check the connection and try again.

settings.barNote: The bar shows at the top of the video when you move the mouse over it. Use it to sync, resize, hide or remove the subtitles without opening this window.
